summary: Southern California Gas Co. filed a 424B5 preliminary prospectus supplement for a debt offering of % First Mortgage Bonds, Series FFF, due 2056. The filing describes the terms of the bonds, including maturity date, interest payment schedule, redemption provisions, and underwriting details. Joint book-running managers include BNP Paribas, CIBC Capital Markets, Mizuho, Wells Fargo Securities, and Academy Securities. This is a routine debt capital markets transaction, not a special situation. No acquisition, divestiture, activist, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, spin-off, restructuring, or other special-situation event is involved.
